comments: Child corrects their own color identification from green to red.
Child corrects the ownership claim, re-asserting that the item is Dad's after a brief contradiction in the previous turns.
Child rejects mother's offer to help ("bōʔi nesadēr laḳ") and wants to do it alone.
Child answers 'what is written in the picture?' by stating nothing is written, indicating nonexistence of text.
Child makes a factual claim that the object is not a cube, correcting the mother's previous suggestions about rolling it.
Child denies the mother's claim that the ear is wet (line 22559).
Child answers 'no' to the factual question 'did you play ball?' and asserts ownership.
Child asks if the object doesn't tickle them because it was closed; this is a factual claim about a property.
Child asks a negative question to confirm the identity of the object after the mother identifies it as an album.
Child uses negative imperative to block Asaf from taking the item, following Mother's requests to give it to him.
Child denies that the other person took the object; the adult's response ('I made a mistake') supports a factual dispute.
Child uses negative imperative 'al tiqxī' to block the action of taking her horse.
Child rejects the current situation or the caregiver's question to demand access to the object ('ten li lirot').
Child asserts that the candle/fire is finished/gone (nigmar), indicating nonexistence of the expected entity.
Child denies mother's claim that Miryam can do what she wants (line 110082).
Child rejects the proposal to tell more to the tape (line 110728), preferring to wait for mom.
Child refuses the mother's proposal to tell a story about Kruvi for Dira (line 110821).
Child responds 'no no' to mother's directive to leave the TV alone and her comments; functions as a rejection of the mother's directive/stance.
Child expresses refusal of the rabbit cake in the context of discussing the album; prefer Rejection over Denial per tie-break.
Child is negotiating which toy to give Quqi; 'don't want rabbits' functions as a veto of the rabbit-themed option mentioned by the mother in line 116238.
Child refuses mother's proposal to put the item in the bag (line 116335).
Child refuses the mother's directive to put an item in the trash (line 117070).
Child denies the mother's characterization of her as a naughty girl (line 117085) and the follow-up question 'ken Hagār ?' (line 117088).
Child refuses the item after Father explains that the doctor does not allow it (line 117193).
Child refuses the caregiver's proposal to go to sleep (line 129053).
Child answers 'no' to the question 'Are you going to kindergarten today?' (line 129110).
Child states that the mother is not helping; mother denies this in the following turn (line 173162).
Child rejects the mother's suggestion to tell a story about 'the mess of Ariq' (line 194985).
Child is narrating a story and reports that the characters did not find the pacifier; this is a factual claim within the narrative.
The target 'Bli Sodot' is the name of a TV show, as confirmed by the mother's follow-up question 'ma hayā ba# Bli Sodōt ?' (line 195228). It is a proper noun, not a negation act.
Child answers 'I don't know' to Mother's question 'Where?' (line 196038).
Child refuses the book offered in line 229700.
Child uses negative imperative to stop the father from saying a specific word ('mexashefa').
Child denies that something was taken from this location, as clarified by the caregiver's follow-up question about the pictures in line 270896.
Child is distinguishing between objects, stating one is a disc and the other is not, clarifying the adult's identification in line 271658.
Child states 'today there is nothing' (ʔeyn klum), expressing the absence of entities.
Child corrects the adult's identification of the object as an album, later specifying it is a book (line 272417).
Child identifies an object as 'Mom' then immediately corrects the identification with 'ze loʔ' (this is not).
Child asserts autonomy ('No, I'll open this') following adult's encouragement to do it alone, rejecting potential help/intervention.
Child is playing doctor; 'ze loʔ koʔēv' (it doesn't hurt) is a factual report about the sensation of the action.
The token 'af' here is the noun for 'nose' (long nose), not a negation.
Child corrects the color of the balloon from blue to yellow after the mother's disagreement in line 285012.
